purpose: A bounded public record of independently checkable artifacts, releases, commits, deployments, and provenance.

methodology.rule: Every entry must identify exactly what the linked evidence proves. Evidence of existence is not evidence of commercial success, scientific validity, customer adoption, or capability beyond the cited artifact.
methodology.claim_boundary: No entry may upgrade a source into a stronger claim than the source supports.

entries.title: Victor mobile voice proof-of-concept
entries.claim: A public Victor commit records a React Native proof-of-concept for on-device transcription using whisper.cpp bindings, including model download, permissions, initialization, and transcription UI.

entries.title: VictorGodcore v4.7 integration commit
entries.claim: A public Victor commit records dataset integration, multimodal training data, FPKTBlock updates, memory-shard ingestion, and training-loop integration.

entries.title: Truth Compiler bounded release governor
entries.claim: The public truth-compiler-ai repository contains a merged commit for a bounded Protector release governor, preceded by tests for replay and capability boundaries and CI coverage.

entries.title: Git-anchored research provenance registry
entries.claim: The site repository contains a commit explicitly publishing a research provenance registry with artifact fingerprints, a deterministic record-set root, browser verification, sitemap registration, and CI proof checks.

entries.title: Truth Compiler proof and privacy funnel
entries.claim: The live-site repository records deployment of a proof-driven audit funnel, public case-study surfaces, customer privacy/data-rights policy, service terms, product manifest, and post-checkout routing.

entries.title: Amplification Governor owner control plane
entries.claim: The live-site repository records deployment of a local-first owner control plane with Idea Vault, Branch Governor, preservation states, audit trail, reactivation triggers, receipts, exports, and data-quality controls.
